N-39 DRAWN 17 Nov 2026 (design PR, docs only; nothing built, nothing walked; the item stays todo until the build). FRAMES. In screens-library-and-browse.html: S-16 "downloaded" stop (Stop under the line and the bar, where the built Retry stands: DownloadStatus), stopping, stopped (files kept, Resume), reopened (a stopped list after a restart), reason (a song something else interrupted); S-17 "playlist" stopped (the line, Resume, the Download button's own stopped state, songs added later wait); NEW row S-96 "dloff" sheet, sheet-stopped, confirm (the question before Remove). In screens-first-run-and-settings.html: S-95 "dlnote" dl-stopped (the result card).

STRINGS (English; Arabic is in the frames). Stop / Resume. "Stopping...". "Stopped Â· 12 of 217 on this phone Â· 40 ready on your server" (no server half when the server has all of it or the live channel is down; never "Stopped Â· Downloading to this phone"). Reason: "Interrupted before it finished." (one branch added to phoneFailureWords for the recorded "The download was stopped" of PR #113; alternative "Stopped before it finished."). Card: "Prog snob is stopped" / "12 of 217 stay on this phone. Resume continues from there." Dialog: "Remove Prog snob from this phone?" / "The 12 songs on this phone (340 MB) are deleted, and the rest will not be downloaded." / "Your music stays on your server and you can download it again. A song that another download also has stays on this phone." [Cancel] [Remove].

DECISIONS, all PROPOSED (the advisor decides while the owner is away; he may change them):
1. Stop is the phone copy only; the server goes on saving. docs/17 has no route that cancels one download's keeping; the songs belong to the library on the server and to every device; an import has its own Stop. COST: a person who wants YouTube eased uses the import's Stop, and a Download of a list that was not an import has no way to stop the server's part.
2. A stopped row keeps its place and section (no "Stopped" section). No Retry on a stopped row (it would send asks); the names of songs that did not come stay.
3. A Download's Stop leaves ONE result card. PB-43 says "nothing when stopped here": kept for an import (its Stop is final), departed from for a Download (it waits for the person).
4. The sheet: Stop is its own row and keeps the files; "Remove download" is always the removal and asks. Today "Stop and remove download" deletes at once (PB-40): so "Stop" meant delete.
5. Every door that turns a WHOLE download off asks (the sheet, the Settings trash button, Remove all). Unchanged: one song's menu Remove, Delete playlist (asks already).

WHAT THE BUILD MUST DO: store the stop in the phone's database FIRST, then cancel the transfers (so the canceled-as-failed branch of #113 never sees it); start(), every pump, sync and reconnect leave a stopped download's rows alone; Resume sends keep/ask again; a stopped download keeps keep/watch; songs added later are neither asked nor copied until Resume; stopped wins over a wait reason. A migration for the stopped flag (next free number) and a docs/33 row with test FILES named.

CHECKS: the page's own check=1 measures 0 issues in all 168 frames of the library file (100 and 200 percent, light and dark, left-to-right and right-to-left). The other two files have no checker: looked at in headless Edge in the same combinations. The 340 MB is sample data.
